newsitem.title: DUBAI: Thomson BankWatch rates three Saudi banks.
newsitem.headline: Thomson BankWatch rates three Saudi banks.

text.p: New York-based Thomson BankWatch said it had assigned ratings to al-Rajhi Banking and Investment Corp, upgraded Saudi Hollandi Bank's intra-country issuer rating and affirmed Riyad Bank ratings.

It said in a statement that al-Rajhi was assigned the highest intra-country rating of A as its dominant market share of Islamic banking products in Saudi Arabia, together with sound management, "has driven continued strong performance and healthy asset quality".
It was assigned a short-term local currency debt rating of LC-1.

Saudi Hollandi Bank was upgraded to intra-country B from B/C "reflecting prospects for continued steady improvement in earnings and asset quality", BankWatch said. Its short-term local currency debt rating was affirmed at LC-1.
The bank is 40 percent held by ABN AMRO Bank.
Riyad Bank was affirmed at IC-A and LC-1.
